## 1.3.28 (HexGhoul): CCG investigators carry their case properly, work as a pair (one in front, one round the back), idle at ease; the quinque case has its own mechanical sound (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.28 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 63**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **The case's own sound (new).** Opening a quinque case (yours or an investigator's) now sounds like a real attaché case on a mechanism: the two latches thumbed back one after the other (a button, then the spring snapping the hasp up), the seal letting go, a geared servo spinning up under it, plates sliding out, two segments locking and the last lock home with a heavy clunk. Shutting it runs the servo back, the halves meet with a deep knock and the two latches snap shut. Both fit the case's 0.6 s, two takes of each so it doesn't repeat, with subtitles ("A quinque case unlocks" / "locks"). They replace the old centipede click and kagune rustle. No recording could be downloaded where this was built, so the sounds are built from their parts (`tools/case_sfx.py`); give them a listen.
- **Investigators hold their case properly.** They carry it by the handle: the fist closed round the handle bar, the case hanging straight down beside the leg with the latches facing out and its length along the stride, clear of the leg. It no longer sticks out across the leg. It stays hanging straight whether they stand, walk, run or lean (it swings a little with the arm as they walk). Your own case in your hand is drawn exactly as before.
- **They work as a pair.** Two investigators on one target no longer charge in one behind the other:
  - **One holds the front.** It comes straight at the target and squares up just out of its reach, keeping its attention, then strikes once its partner is round the back, when the target comes at it, or after about three seconds.
  - **The other goes round the back.** It swings wide (about 5.5 blocks out, past a kagune's reach) round its own side of the first one, never cutting across it, and comes in from behind. No front flips straight at the target while it's going round.
  - **They swap.** Turn your back on the one in front to fight the one behind for a second and a half, and they swap: the one now behind you goes in, the one now in front holds.
  - With the launcher in the pair, the launcher always holds the front from range and the other one goes round the back.
- **Idle animation (new).** Standing about out of a fight they look relaxed and a bit cocky: leaning back a little from the hips, weight on the right leg with the left loose and turned out, the upper body tipped slightly away from the case, chest a little open, head cocked, the free arm hanging loose. They breathe, and now and then glance off to one side. The two of a pair don't breathe in step.

Untested in game: the new sound, the carried case, the pair's tactics and the idle are only compiled and unit tested.
